newsitem.title: USA: CIGNA Corp Q1 oper shr $3.49 vs $2.85.
newsitem.headline: CIGNA Corp Q1 oper shr $3.49 vs $2.85.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: First Call consensus estimate for Q1 operating earnings was $3.11 a share.
Q1 net earnings were $288 million, or $3.86 a share, compared with $238 million, or $3.10 a share a year ago.
Q1 net income includes after-tax realized investment gains of $28 million, or $0.37 a share, compared with gains of $19 million or $0.25 a share a year ago.
Ongoing property-casualty operations had a combined ratio of 100 percent in 1997 Q1 compared with 105 percent a year ago.
Ongoing property-casualty operations had $8 million in after-tax catastrophe losses in 1997 Q1 compared with $15 million a year ago.
